title: Vibrant Mind Map for Creative Thinking
summary: This prompt generates a vibrant and organic mind map centered on "Creative Thinking." It uses unique colors and relevant icons for branches, with a friendly, handwritten font, ideal for educational and brainstorming tool.
prompt: A vibrant and organic mind map centered around the topic of “Creative Thinking.” The central idea is in a cloud-like shape, with branches extending to sub-topics like “Brainstorming,” “Mindfulness,” “Divergent Thinking,” and “Collaboration.” Each branch should have a unique color and be accompanied by a small, relevant icon (e.g., a lightbulb for ideas). The text should be in a friendly, handwritten font, showcasing a tool for educational and brainstorming purposes. –ar 16:9
